title: fix(ui): recover hidden progress refresh startup and canceled retries
body:
Related: #154044

## What Problem This Solves

Progress refresh can abort during hidden session preparation. Retrying a canceled queued refresh can also replay its old acceptance without starting an update.

## User Impact

Hidden status refreshes can prepare their session without becoming visible chat turns, and canceled queued requests can be retried with a new intent. Existing authorization, cancellation, replacement and terminal-run fences remain enforced. No UI layout, configuration, schema or dependency changes.

## Why This Change Was Made

This is the six-file correction for the two later review findings on #154044, which merged while these repairs were being verified. Hidden presentation is no longer mistaken for loss of admission liveness. Queued cancellation records its canonical receipt while the exact owner still exists, before removal; stale owners cannot overwrite successors.

## Worked on by

- @steipete
- @shakkernerd

## Work sessions

- [Discussion, implementation and verification](https://team.openclaw.ai/chat/roboclaw/dashboard/e187ebb9-ab5b-42bf-9f12-2ef9a85edd00)

## Evidence

- Five regressions fail on the parent: idle and rejected-steer refresh preparation through the real admission callback; single, bulk and signal cancellation followed by refresh retry.
- After repair, 60 tests pass across preparation/admission, real queued execution, queued cancellation and dispatch-error suites. The hidden preparation callback also rejects late use after settlement.
- Production core and complete Gateway-method/root test type graphs pass. Targeted lint has zero warnings/errors; formatting, line-cap and diff checks pass.
- Independent AutoReview is clean through P2. The correction was cherry-picked patch-identically onto current main; the original feature is not included again.
- The queue tests execute real enqueue/drain/lifecycle/followup-runner code with controlled provider/session edges. No live-provider result is claimed.

One-worker command wall cost (including startup/transformation) for the changed test files:

| Test file | Wall |
|---|---:|
| `progress-card-refresh.integration.test.ts` | 24.920 s |
| `progress-card-refresh.queued.test.ts` | 7.828 s |
| `chat-queued-turns.test.ts` | 1.919 s |

Exact-head hosted CI is required before landing. No Gateway deployment or restart is included.
